name: Oomiya Itsuki
source: Hana and Aoi's friend and former member of the track team. A girl of bubbly and energetic personality, she often comes up with the craziest of ideas and shows a wide variety of emotions, from laughing to pouting and crying. Still, she is a caring person in a subtle way and doesn't go too far in her whims.
